run_doxygen_postprocessing: run the doxygen post-processing script on a reference.xml file to clean and sanitize documentation
remove_unnamed_template_parameters: remove unnamed and Detail-prefixed template parameters from Doxygen XML to hide SFINAE implementation details
replace_detail_types_with_unspecified: replace types containing detail or _impl in their names with unspecified placeholders in Doxygen output
hide_deprecated_typedefs: remove deprecated typedefs from Doxygen XML by checking their purpose tag for deprecated status
sort_and_cleanup_doxygen_xml: sort headers by path depth, sort namespace items alphabetically, and strip trailing whitespace from Doxygen XML
